habitat_classification.note: Exotic; not part of Bangladesh wild fauna

gallery.photographer: Photograph by Jere Kyyrö. Uploaded by Rasvis.

identification.text: Stocky, deep-bodied livebearer without a caudal sword; males to 4 cm, females to 6 cm. Wild fish are drab olive and notably lack the dark lateral line common to many Xiphophorus species. Separated from X. hellerii by absence of the sword and stockier build; from X. variatus by shorter dorsal fin and stockier body - though trade fish are usually hellerii/maculatus/variatus hybrids.
references: Wikipedia: Southern platyfish (6 cm; drab wild; no dark lateral line)
mexican-fish.com: Southern Platyfish (no lateral line; no sword)
USFWS ERSS (hybridisation of the three species)

physical_characteristics.text: Males 4.0 cm TL, females 6.0 cm TL; common male length 2.4 cm TL (FishBase). Dozens of selectively bred colour varieties exist, many produced by crossing with X. hellerii or X. variatus; many commercial platies are weakened by inbreeding and over-production and are prone to disease and premature death (SeriouslyFish).
references: FishBase: Xiphophorus maculatus summary page (4 cm male; 6 cm female)
SeriouslyFish: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (varieties; inbreeding weakness)

male_vs_female.text: Females are larger (to 6 cm) and deeper-bodied; males smaller (to 4 cm), slimmer, with a gonopodium. Females are plain olive in wild form; males slightly more colourful.
references: USGS NAS: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (females 6 cm; males 4 cm)
FishBase: Xiphophorus maculatus summary page

natural_habitat.text: Native to the Atlantic coastal plain: Ciudad Veracruz, Mexico, south and east to northern Belize (FishBase), with SeriouslyFish extending the range to Guatemala and Nicaragua. Non-migratory; prefers slow-moving waters of canals, ditches and warm springs with silt bottoms and weedy banks, in 18-25 C water (mexican-fish.com). Introduced populations are locally established in several US states (Florida, Hawaii, Nevada, Colorado), Fiji and elsewhere.
references: FishBase: Xiphophorus maculatus summary page (Veracruz to N. Belize; warm springs; canals; ditches)
mexican-fish.com: Southern Platyfish (18-25 C; slow waters)
USGS NAS: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (introduced populations USA)

bangladesh_distribution.text: Not native to Bangladesh - included for the comparative aquarium chapter. Platy is the fifth most popular ornamental species in Dhaka trade (5.93%, Hossain & Mohsin 2021); the Katabon market survey lists Xiphophorus maculatus sourced from Singapore, India, Thailand and locally bred in Dhaka (ResearchGate trade paper). Feral/wild establishment in Bangladesh: no published record found in the sources consulted - Unknown.
references: Hossain & Mohsin 2021: Native and non-native ornamental aquarium fishes of Bangladesh (platy 5.93%)
ResearchGate: Insights into the emerging ornamental fish trade in the capital of Bangladesh (X. maculatus listed)

south_asian_distribution.text: Not native to South Asia. Native range: Atlantic slope of Mexico to northern Belize (SeriouslyFish adds Guatemala and Nicaragua - minor source difference, Moderate confidence on the extended range). No confirmed South Asian feral population in the sources consulted.
references: SeriouslyFish: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (Atlantic coastal plain; Guatemala, Belize, Nicaragua)
USGS NAS: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (Atlantic slope, Mexico to Belize)

environmental_requirements.text: WILD: 18-25 C (FishBase), pH 7.0-8.0, dH 9-19; slow warm waters with vegetation. AQUARIUM: 20-26 C, hard alkaline water; avoid soft acidic conditions, as with other livebearers. Keep wild and aquarium regimes separate.
references: FishBase: Xiphophorus maculatus summary page (18-25 C; pH 7-8; dH 9-19)
SeriouslyFish: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (avoid soft acidic water)

feeding_and_behaviour.text: Omnivorous; wild diet of small invertebrates, algae and detritus. Peaceful and docile - an ideal community fish, much calmer than mollies. Prolific; populations increase rapidly where introduced and have been implicated in declines of native fishes (mexican-fish.com).
references: SeriouslyFish: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (peaceful community fish)
mexican-fish.com: Southern Platyfish (rapid reproduction; native-fish declines)
USGS NAS (decline of native damselflies, Oahu)

breeding_and_reproduction.text: Livebearer: sexual maturity at 3-4 months (FishBase); broods of 20-80 fry every few weeks; no parental care. Breeds easily in captivity; females store sperm and produce successive broods. Hybridises freely with X. hellerii and X. variatus - most trade platies are hybrids.
references: FishBase: Xiphophorus maculatus summary page (maturity 3-4 months; reproduces easily; 60 cm tank)
cvasu.ac.bd ornamental fish thesis (platy culture; 4 months to reproduce; 3-year lifespan)

lifespan_and_growth.text: About 3 years (cvasu thesis); fast growth and early maturity. Inbred commercial strains may live shorter lives.
references: cvasu.ac.bd ornamental fish thesis (platy lifespan 3 years)

conservation_status.text: IUCN Red List: Data Deficient (assessed 2018, published 2019 by Daniels) - very limited documentation of wild biology. NatureServe ranks it Secure. Introduced populations have reported adverse ecological impacts (FishBase; USGS NAS - implicated in native damselfly declines on Oahu).
references: IUCN Red List: Xiphophorus maculatus (Daniels 2019; assessed 2018; DD)
mexican-fish.com: Southern Platyfish (Data Deficient)
USGS NAS: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (ecological impacts)

captive_care_notes.text: Minimum 60 cm tank; one of the hardiest beginner livebearers. Hard alkaline planted water; peaceful community fish. Buy quality stock from breeders rather than mass-produced shop fish, which are often weakened. Males-only groups or sex separation prevents population explosions.
references: FishBase: Xiphophorus maculatus summary page (60 cm minimum)
SeriouslyFish: Xiphophorus maculatus species profile (buy quality stock; hardy beginner fish)

research_gaps.text: Wild biology is data-deficient - population status, spawning ecology and habitat use in the native range are poorly documented (hence the IUCN DD listing). The genetic identity of trade hybrids versus pure wild populations is unresolved. Unknown.
references: IUCN Red List: Xiphophorus maculatus (DD)
mexican-fish.com: Southern Platyfish (very limited documentation)

bn.identification: ছোট মোটা livebearer — পুরুষ ~৩-৪ cm, স্ত্রী ~৫-৬ cm। বন্য রূপ olive-gray, কালো দাগসহ; domestic strain লাল, কমলা, হলুদ, নীল ও 'mickey mouse' নকশায়। Swordtail (X. hellerii) থেকে ছোট আকার, মোটা দেহ ও পুরুষে sword-এর অনুপস্থিতিতে পৃথক। পুরুষের gonopodium আছে।
bn.physical_characteristics: FishBase রেকর্ড করে সর্বোচ্চ 6.0 cm TL। Domestic morph: red, sunset, tuxedo, mickey mouse, wagtail, hi-fin, lyretail। বন্য মাছ নিস্তেজ — domestic রং artificial selection-এর ফসল।
bn.male_vs_female: পুরুষ ছোট, gonopodium ও উজ্জ্বল রং-সহ; স্ত্রী বড়, গোলগাল, gravid spot-সহ।
bn.natural_habitat: মধ্য আমেরিকার দেশীয়: মেক্সিকো, বেলিজ ও গুয়াতেমালার Atlantic-ঢালের নিম্নভূমি — ধীর-প্রবাহিত স্রোত, খাল, পুকুর ও জলাভূমি; ঘন উদ্ভিদ পছন্দ করে।
bn.bangladesh_distribution: বাংলাদেশের দেশীয় নয় — তুলনামূলক aquarium অধ্যায়ের জন্য অন্তর্ভুক্ত। Platy বাংলাদেশ ornamental trade-এ প্রতিষ্ঠিত: ঢাকার ornamental survey তালিকাভুক্ত করে (Hossain ও Mohsin ২০২১)। বাংলাদেশে feral/বন্য প্রতিষ্ঠা: পরামর্শকৃত উৎসগুলোতে কোনো প্রকাশিত রেকর্ড পাওয়া যায়নি — Unknown।
bn.south_asian_distribution: দক্ষিণ এশিয়ার দেশীয় নয়। আদি পরিসর মধ্য আমেরিকার Atlantic-ঢাল (মেক্সিকো, বেলিজ, গুয়াতেমালা)। Ornamental প্রজাতি হিসেবে দক্ষিণ এশিয়ায় ব্যাপকভাবে traded।
bn.environmental_requirements: বন্য পরিবেশ: ১৮-২৮ °C, pH ৭.০-৮.০, dH ১০-২৫ (FishBase)। Aquarium: ২০-২৬ °C, pH ৭.০-৮.০, মাঝারি-শক্ত পানি। বন্য ও aquarium ব্যবস্থা আলাদা রাখুন।
bn.feeding_and_behaviour: Omnivorous: বন্য খাদ্য algae, detritus ও ছোট invertebrate; aquarium-এ flake ও vegetable matter নেয়। খুব শান্তিপূর্ণ, beginner-বান্ধব; community ট্যাংকে ভালো থাকে।
bn.breeding_and_reproduction: Livebearer; gestation ৪-৬ সপ্তাহ; brood ২০-৪০টি fry। Swordtail-এর সঙ্গে সহজে hybridise করে — উর্বর বংশধর; খাঁটি line পৃথক রাখুন। Fry planted cover-এ ভালো বাঁচে।
bn.lifespan_and_growth: Aquarium-এ ২-৩ বছর। বৃদ্ধি দ্রুত; মাসের মধ্যে পরিণত হয়।
bn.conservation_status: IUCN Red List: Least Concern। প্রজাতি ব্যাপক; trade সম্পূর্ণ captive-bred।
bn.captive_care_notes: ছোট দলের জন্য ন্যূনতম ৪০-৬০ L planted ট্যাংক; ২০-২৬ °C, pH ৭.০-৮.০, মাঝারি-শক্ত পানি। Beginner-বান্ধব; swordtail-এর সঙ্গে একসঙ্গে রাখবেন না (hybridisation)।
bn.research_gaps: বন্য জনসংখ্যার genetic অবস্থা বনাম domestic introgression অগবেষিত। প্রবর্তিত পরিসরে ecological প্রভাব খারাপভাবে নথিভুক্ত।

bn_img.sb_rationale: সহজ livebearing, দ্রুত প্রজন্ম ও বিপুল colour morph — strain development-এর জন্য আদর্শ beginner মাছ।
bn_img.hyb_text: যাচাইকৃত: X. maculatus × X. hellerii সহজে hybridise করে — উর্বর বংশধর; খাঁটি species line পৃথক রাখুন।
bn_img.mkt_text: প্রধান commercial livebearer — platy বিশ্বব্যাপী pet-store staple; mass captive-bred, steady বৈশ্বিক চাহিদা।
bn_img.mf_text: পুরুষ ছোট (~৩-৪ cm), gonopodium ও উজ্জ্বল রং-সহ; স্ত্রী বড় (~৫-৬ cm), গোলগাল, gravid spot-সহ।
